answer: Each identity binds one face in the juniper registry: a camera records a 3D face map, hashed into the river ledger, with a 30 POA bond locked 90 days. Each epoch a random nectar liveness check demands a head-turn video within 10 minutes; two misses forfeit half the bond and freeze payouts 3 epochs. A face shared by two identities loses both bonds. 100 fakes need 100 faces at $40 each plus 3,000 POA locked; bought faces grow dearer fast, doubling in price every 25 sold, so the 100th costs 8 times the first. Verifiers replay the river ledger each epoch. Twins pass a joint in-person check.
